topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the topic of cancer evolution, outlines the learning objectives, and previews the factors that shape tumor development.

topics.label: Clonal Evolution and Epigenetic Drivers
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how tumors evolve through the progressive selection of fitter clones driven by genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and the Cancer Stem Cell Model
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how normal tissue stem cell hierarchies and cellular origin influence cancer initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Influences on Tumor Growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how extrinsic microenvironmental signals, chronic inflammation, and supportive stroma enable mutant cells to expand and maintain tumor growth.

topics.label: Experimental Technologies for Investigating Tumor Biology
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the genomic, single-cell, and spatial profiling methods used to map tumor heterogeneity and cell-microenvironment interactions.

topics.label: Synthesis of Cancer Evolution and Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics synthesise the lecture's core themes regarding the multi-factorial nature of cancer evolution and conclude the session.
